description: How far along something is, at a glance: the share of an invoice collected, of items reviewed, of a checklist done. `value` runs from 0 to `max` (1 by default, as on a native `<meter>`); a value outside that range draws at the nearer end, so an empty meter still shows its track and a full one fills it. The bar is drawn as the page renders, on the server and before JavaScript.
